import java.util.Scanner;

public class Div2_630_E {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long L = sc.nextLong();
        long R = sc.nextLong();
        
        long total = R - L + 1;
        long oddCount;
        if (L % 2 == 1) {
            oddCount = (total + 1) / 2;
        } else {
            oddCount = total / 2;
        }
        long evenCount = total - oddCount;
        
        long cells = n * m;
        
        if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
            long result = power(oddCount + evenCount, cells);
            System.out.println(result);
        } else {
            long result = (power(evenCount, cells) + power(oddCount, cells)) % MOD;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }

    private static long power(long base, long exp) {
        base %= MOD;
        if (exp == 0) return 1;
        if (exp == 1) return base;
        long half = power(base, exp / 2);
        if (exp % 2 == 0) {
            return half * half % MOD;
        } else {
            return half * half % MOD * base % MOD;
        }
    }
}
